history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration take steps to make it mandatory that all cases of fraud and suspected fraud be reported, as they come to notice, by all third-party administrators.
history.administration_response: The Procurement Division provided an update to the Board on 19 April 2023 regarding the status of contracts for third-party administrators aimed at addressing the recommendation. Going forward, the Procurement Division will be responsible for providing updates on the recommendation. The Division is responsible for establishing written agreements with vendors, including third-party administrators, that provide goods and/or services to the United Nations. The Division is currently following up on outstanding comments from some third-party administrators before finalizing a unified approach to address all third-party administrator comments, which includes leveraging negotiation power on the United Nations General Conditions of Contract. The Division will engage relevant stakeholders (e.g. the Office of Legal Affairs) to provide a response to each third-party administrator towards the conclusion of related agreements. The revised target date is set for 31 December 2023.
history.board_assessment: Given that the negotiations with all third-party administrators to ensure a consolidated strategy are still pending, the Board considers this recommendation to be under implementation.
